reopened_reason: EW-RS-066 tests whether exact positive frontier-relative depth can be compressed inside the successful whole-component ROLE_CAPPAR+ZOE identity and separates interaction-level timing sufficiency from whole-identity sufficiency.

new_assertions.body: Sufficiency is role-sensitive: a descriptor may be sufficient as an interaction coordinate while losing Q-V information when used as the entire component identity before ZOE aggregation. Therefore interaction-coordinate compression cannot be promoted automatically to whole-identity compression.

Within the frozen depth ladder, exact frontier-relative depth is necessary for one common ROLE_CAPPAR whole-component identity across the five declared carriers: frontier-only fails all five and RPAR fails 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4.

RPAR and exact depth induce the same selected class count with zero scalar mixing on 5x3-k3, 6x3-k3, and 6x3-k4, but not on 4x4-k4 or 4x5-k4. Depth compression is therefore geometry/corpus dependent rather than an exact representation identity of ROLE_CAPPAR in general.

The preferred decoder coordinate remains absolute-owner ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE with exact relative depths. OOO dependency-residue analysis should continue in that coordinate rather than a depth-parity compression.

Any future common depth compression must be frozen structurally and must separate the 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4 RPAR mixed classes without outcome-selected exceptions; otherwise exact depth remains the current MSS candidate.
EW-RS-059 formula holdouts remain sealed because EW-RS-066 is an identity-compression experiment and does not freeze a closed scalar syndrome family.
